name: material-you
title: applyMaterialYou
description: Map Android's wallpaper-derived Material You palette onto the design-system surface and accent tokens.
docs: Android 12+ publishes five wallpaper-derived tonal ramps of 13 stops each; a native shell reads them and this maps them onto the DS tokens. Stops run light to dark (0 is white, 1000 is black), the opposite of the DS accent scale. The mapping keeps the surface ladder in order, re-points the neutral steps that are equal to a surface by construction, and leaves the page and edge chrome to the OLED overlay when extraDark is set. Pair materialYouAccent with applyAccentColor for the accent, and materialYouThemeColors with useTheme's themeColors so native chrome follows.
